_comment: The app's Prime products. play_subscriptions.py and asc_subscriptions.py create the auto-renewing subscriptions in each store; revenuecat_products.py adds every product (subscriptions and the one-time Lifetime purchase) to RevenueCat with the entitlement, offering and packages the app reads. Prime Lifetime is created in the store consoles (see store_listing/). Product ids must match PremiumPlan in lib/services/premium_service.dart. Prices are USD; each store converts them for other countries.

en-US.name: Prime Monthly
en-US.description: Unlimited cleaning and every scan, monthly
benefits: SD card, USB and custom folders

subscriptions.review_note: Removes the free limits (100 files and 500 MB per clean) and unlocks every scan type, storage location and filter. Restore is on the paywall.
